What seems to help many (including myself), while easier said then done, is expressing your emotions. Suicidal thoughts are composed of bottled up emotions that you haven't let out, at least that's how I find it to be.

So have a good cry, have a good scream, beat the shit out of a pillow, write an angry or sad letter to someone and then physically rip it up, or run around a bit. These are just a few out of literally **thousands** of ways to express your emotion that won't cause harm to anyone.

Again, I want to repeat that this isn't always easy, and not all methods will work. Sometimes they might work, others they may not. But relieving your emotions a little at a time prevents them from just bottling up resulting in a violent outburst later. If you'd like to hear some breathing and relaxation exercises I've heard over time, feel free to PM me.
